name: Silent Magician LV4
extDescription: Each time your opponent draws a card, place 1 Magic counter on this card (max: 5 counters). For each Magic counter on this card, increase 500 ATK points. When there are 5 Magic counters, during your next Standby Phase send this face-up card to the Graveyard and Special Summon 1 "Silent Magician LV8" from your hand or Deck.

name: Silent Magician LV8
extDescription: This card can not be Normal Summoned. It can only be Special Summoned by the effect of "Silent Magician LV4". This card can not be affected by your opponent's magic.

name: Magician's Circle
extDescription: You can put this card in effect when a Spellcaster Monster has declared an attack. Players choose 1 Spellcaster Monster with ATK 2000 or lower from their own deck and Special Summon it in face-up Attack Position on their own field.
